cards.text: Friend, things are tense. While Moses, Israel's leader, was up on the mountain, the people made a golden calf and bowed down to it (Exodus 32:8). Now the LORD tells Moses to leave this place with the people and go to the land He promised to Israel's forefathers Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

cards.question: God says He'll send someone ahead of the people to drive out the Canaanites, the Amorites and the other nations in the land. Who does He send?

cards.text: It's a land flowing with milk and honey. Sounds perfect, right? Then God says the next part, and it is NOT the part anybody wanted.

cards.question: God says He Himself will go with the people to the land.
God says He won't go with the people, or He might destroy them on the way. What does He call them?

cards.text: The people hear this bad news, and they go into mourning. A whole camp making the face you make when your boss says, "Hey, got a minute?"

cards.question: As the people mourn, no one puts on any of his ___.

cards.text: The LORD had already given Moses a message for them. You are stiff-necked, and if I went with you for a single moment, I would destroy you.

cards.question: In that message, the LORD tells the Israelites to take off their jewelry, and He will decide what to do with them.

cards.text: So from Mount Horeb onward, the Israelites strip off their jewelry. After the last batch of gold earrings turned into a calf (Exodus 32:3-4), I'd be nervous around jewelry too.
Now the story shows us something Moses used to do. He'd take a tent and pitch it, and he called it the Tent of Meeting.

cards.question: Where does Moses pitch the Tent of Meeting?

answers.text: At a distance outside the camp
Right in the middle of the camp
Up on top of the mountain

cards.question: Who goes out to the Tent of Meeting?
Whenever Moses walks out to the Tent of Meeting, what does the rest of the camp do?

answers.text: Stand at their tent doors and watch him
Follow him all the way out there
Stay inside with the flaps closed

cards.text: Every eye in the camp follows him until he's inside. Then, as Moses enters, something comes down and stays right at the entrance.

cards.question: What comes down and stays at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting?
When the people see the pillar of cloud at the tent, they stand up and worship, each one at the entrance to his own tent.
Inside the Tent of Meeting, the LORD speaks with Moses. How?

answers.text: Face to face like a friend

cards.text: Then Moses heads back to camp. But one person is NOT leaving that tent, and honestly, that's me at the oven door when the batch has two minutes left.

cards.question: When Moses goes back to the camp, who stays in the Tent of Meeting?

cards.text: Now Moses talks to the LORD. He says, You keep telling me to lead this people up, but You haven't let me know whom You will send with me.

cards.question: Moses reminds the LORD that He said He knows Moses by name.

cards.text: So Moses makes a request. If he really has found favor in God's sight, there's something he wants.

cards.question: What does Moses ask the LORD to let him know?

answers.text: His ways so Moses may know Him
The day they will reach the land
The names of every enemy ahead

cards.question: Moses adds, "Remember that this nation is Your people." What does the LORD answer?

answers.text: His Presence will go and give rest
An angel will go and guard them
Moses will go and lead them alone

cards.text: Moses answers, “If Your Presence does not go with us, do not lead us up from here.” Translation: this car is NOT leaving the driveway without You.

cards.question: Moses says God going with them is how it can be known that something is true. What?

answers.text: They have found favor in His sight
They are the strongest nation on earth
Moses is the greatest leader of all

cards.question: Because Moses has found favor in His sight and He knows Moses by name, the LORD agrees to do the very thing Moses asked.

cards.text: If God told me yes, I'd back out of the room slowly before anybody changed their mind. Moses? Moses asks for something even BIGGER.

cards.question: What does Moses ask the LORD to show him?

cards.text: The LORD says He will cause all His goodness to pass before Moses. ALL of it, friend.

cards.question: As His goodness passes by, what will the LORD proclaim in Moses's presence?

cards.text: Then He says, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.” But He adds one limit.

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses he can see His face.
Why can't Moses see the LORD's face?

answers.text: No one can see Him and live

cards.text: The LORD has it all arranged: there's a place near Him where Moses is to stand upon a rock. Meanwhile, I can't remember where I set down my rolling pin five minutes ago.

cards.question: When the LORD's glory passes by, where will He put Moses?

answers.text: In a cleft of the rock

cards.text: He will cover Moses with His hand until He has passed by. Then He will take His hand away.

cards.question: When the LORD takes His hand away, what will Moses see?

cards.text: His back, but His face must not be seen. And that's where we'll leave Moses for now, friend, because trust me, this story is NOT done.

findings.problem: Stop 2, card 6 quotes "If Your Presence does not go with us, do not lead us up from here.", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

findings.problem: The question says God will send someone ahead 'to drive out the Canaanites, the Amorites and the other nations.' That makes the angel the one who drives them out. In Exodus 33:2 the LORD says 'I will send an angel before you, and I will drive out' the nations. So the LORD is the one who drives them out, and the text doesn't link the angel to that task.

rule.text: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

findings.problem: 'After the last batch of gold earrings turned into a calf (Exodus 32:3-4), I'd be nervous around jewelry too.' The word 'too' says the Israelites took off their jewelry because they were nervous about the calf. Exodus 33:5-6 says they did it because the LORD told them to. Neither text connects the jewelry in 33:6 to the earrings in 32:3-4.

rule.text: When he connects two passages, or explains what a law was for, he says only what the texts state.

findings.problem: Multiple choice takes 8 of the 12 choice cards. There are 3 true or false cards and only 1 fill in the blank, so multiple choice dominates the stop by a wide margin.

rule.text: No stop repeats another stop's pattern, and no type dominates a stop by a wide margin.

findings.problem: Multiple choice takes 8 of the 11 choice cards, with 3 true or false cards and no fill in the blank. Multiple choice dominates by a wide margin, and the type mix is almost the same as Stop 1's.

rule.text: No stop repeats another stop's pattern, and no type dominates a stop by a wide margin.

findings.problem: The wrong answer 'An angel will go and guard them' is close to true elsewhere in the passage. In Exodus 33:2 the LORD says 'I will send an angel before you.' A baker could argue that an angel is going with them.

rule.text: Each wrong answer must be false anywhere in the passage, not just at that moment.

findings.problem: No card covers the second half of Exodus 33:16: 'How else will we be distinguished from all the other people on the face of the earth?' This is part of why Moses insists on God's Presence. It is an important detail of the passage, and it never gets told.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.

findings.problem: 'As His goodness passes by' says the LORD proclaims His name at the same moment His goodness passes. Exodus 33:19 joins the two only with 'and,' so it doesn't say how they connect in time.

rule.text: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

findings.problem: The closing line 'And that's where we'll leave Moses for now, friend, because trust me, this story is NOT done' nearly copies the doc's example line instead of being written fresh.

rule.text: The examples show the idea. Write your own line each time.
